content.comment_body: Hello, I need some assistance regarding the [company_name] [product_name] SF command, specifically the EDGE TRIGGERED WIPING RELAY. My question is: if we connect X (no contact) to the Reset (R) port of this command, how does that change how the command operates? Additionally, how can I set it to be connected by default, meaning R from the x connector? This is urgent, so any guidance would be appreciated. Thank you! [user_name]

Hi, In general: Inputs on the left side of a function block do not need to be connected unless you require that particular function. It's best to use the [product_name] simulation mode to experiment with the functions, check the manual, or use the help function (F1) for more details. If Reset is left unconnected, then any pulse on enable will start the ON-time using the configured parameters. If nothing else happens, the configured OFF-time will follow after this. Hope this clarifies things.
